name: flow-chapter-pipeline
description: Run a Flow chapter in parallel using task briefs, CLI checklist sync, model routing, and chapter review.

chapter_id.description: Optional chapter directory slug to pin execution.

tasks.description: Optional ordered task worksheet relative paths.

single_chapter.description: Pin execution to chapter_id instead of running ready tasks across all ready chapters.

all_ready_chapters.description: Run ready tasks across all unblocked chapters.

allow_uncommitted.description: Allow uncommitted deferred-commit receipts in post-execution OKF validation.

base_commit.description: Base Git commit SHA prior to execution.

execution_mode.description: Run via parallel worker pool (default), chapter batch, or one task at a time.

harness.description: Active harness identifier for model routing.

tasks_per_worker.description: Maximum tasks per worker batch (default 4; clamped 1..20).

executor_agent.description: Optional custom agent profile for execution.

reviewer_agent.description: Optional custom agent profile for review.
